title: Coinduced discrete modules are acyclic for continuous cochains
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group, $A$ a finite ring, and $M$ a left $A$-module with a continuous $A$-linear $G$-action when $M$ has the discrete topology [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian]. Let $D(M)=\operatorname{Cont}(G,M)$ carry the discrete topology and the action $(h\cdot f)(x)=f(xh)$; it is a discrete continuous $G$-module [lem-exc-coinduced-discrete-embedding]. Form the inhomogeneous complex $C^n(G,D(M))=\operatorname{Cont}(G^n,D(M))$ with $d^0v(g)=g v-v$ and $d^nF(g_1,\ldots,g_{n+1})=g_1F(g_2,\ldots,g_{n+1})+\sum_{j=1}^n(-1)^jF(g_1,\ldots,g_jg_{j+1},\ldots,g_{n+1})+(-1)^{n+1}F(g_1,\ldots,g_n)$ for $n\geq1$. Then $H^q(C^\bullet(G,D(M)))=0$ for every $q>0$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-exc-coinduced-homotopy-identity] to obtain continuous linear differentials $d^n$ and contractions $h_{n+1}$ on $\operatorname{LocallyConstant}(G^n,\operatorname{LocallyConstant}(G,M))$, with their pointwise formulas and $d^nh_{n+1}+h_{n+2}d^{n+1}=1$. This statement already includes the continuous contractions, so no separate application of the continuity lemma is needed.

proof.text: Postcompose cochains with the given coefficient equivalence $e_D$, and compose with $e_K$ to obtain linear equivalences $e_n:K^n\simeq\operatorname{LocallyConstant}(G^n,\operatorname{LocallyConstant}(G,M))$. Evaluate the displayed differential formulas on a tuple and at $x\in G$. The action compatibility $e_D(gf)(x)=e_D(f)(xg)$ identifies the leading terms, and linearity and evaluation commute with each alternating sum. Hence $e_{n+1}d_K^n=d^ne_n$. The homotopy of [lem-exc-coinduced-homotopy-identity] therefore applies to this realization of the cochain complex.

proof.text: Write $q=p+1>0$. If $z\in K^{p+1}$ satisfies $d_Kz=0$, the differential compatibility gives $d^{p+1}e_{p+1}(z)=0$. Apply [lem-exc-coinduced-homotopy-identity] to obtain $d^ph_{p+1}e_{p+1}(z)=e_{p+1}(z)$. Differential compatibility and injectivity of $e_{p+1}$ show that $e_p^{-1}h_{p+1}e_{p+1}(z)$ is a preimage of $z$ under $d_K^p$. Mathlib ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff proves exactness at $q$, and HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology gives the desired zero homology.
